_about: The hand classification of every Canopus retake (anchor_replaced) that predates the declared --cause field, keyed by 'ts|label'. Read by scripts/utils/gate_yield.load_hand_classified. Each entry carries the RAW PROSE REASON recorded at the time beside its class, so every line can be checked against what was actually written rather than against the classifier's summary of it. THIS IS JUDGEMENT, NOT MEASUREMENT: the same classifier passed over these records twice on 2026-08-03 and disagreed on three of them, which is why the report names the hand-classified count on its own page and why no test asserts a total. A retake recorded after the field landed carries its cause structurally and needs no entry here; the structural cause always wins over this file for the same record. Classes: contract-strengthened, enforcer-moved, lint, frozen-set-wrong.
